findings.title: Model router call log file is missing

evidence.observation: Router status indicates call_log_exists is false for path /opt/starship-endeavour/core/model-router/call_log.jsonl

proposed_action.description: Ensure the model router service initializes and writes metrics/audit events to call_log.jsonl on invocation.

findings.expected_benefit: Enables latency, failure rate, and usage tracking across local and cloud LLM routing.

findings.title: Hardcoded default fallback API keys in scoped client and emergency alert service

evidence.observation: Emergency alert module fetches GEMINI_API_KEY with empty string fallback directly in call invocation
Test confirms gateway API key defaults or returns hardcoded legacy token

proposed_action.description: Ensure API key access validates non-empty presence via centralized secrets management rather than silent empty/legacy fallbacks.

findings.expected_benefit: Prevents silent downstream unauthorized calls and improves secret hygiene.
